items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Kind of like Nelson, but heavy Nelson. So, yeah. Nice guitar player.

ctx.x: Hippolyte Charles, yeah. Yeah, yeah. That's right. That's right. Uh-huh. And, uh, who else? I don't know who's playing clarinet or who's playing bass, but I can't think. Cause I was quite young, you know. See, they was playing before I had the band up before I started playing. Mm-hmm. Um, I remember Phillip Nixon well. Tall, brown-skinned father. Kind of like Nelson, but heavy Nelson. So, yeah. Nice guitar player. Mm-hmm.
